# AstroFree

> AstroFree is a free AI-powered tarot reading and Vedic numerology platform. It offers instant AI-guided tarot readings across 8 spreads (including the 10-card Celtic Cross, 3-card spread, Career spread, and Yes/No oracle), Card of the Day meanings for all 78 cards, and free Mulank, Bhagyank, and Namank Vedic numerology calculators with support for 13 Indian languages and no signup required.

All core features are completely free with no paywall, credit card, or account requirement.

## Core Tools & Spreads

- [AstroFree Home](https://astrofree.vercel.app/): Overview of tarot readings, Card of the Day insights, and Vedic numerology tools.
- [Free Tarot Reading App](https://astrofree.vercel.app/reading): Draw cards interactively and receive AI-guided tarot interpretations.
- [Celtic Cross 10-Card Tarot Spread](https://astrofree.vercel.app/tarot/celtic-cross): Instant 10-card spread with position breakdown and upright/reversed analysis.
- [Three-Card Tarot Spread](https://astrofree.vercel.app/tarot/three-card): Past, Present, Future interactive 3-card reading.
- [Career Tarot Reading](https://astrofree.vercel.app/career-tarot-reading): 3-card career & finances pull plus Life Path 1–9 career guide.
- [Yes or No Tarot Oracle](https://astrofree.vercel.app/yes-no-tarot): Instant Yes, No, or Maybe single-card oracle answer.
- [Mulank & Bhagyank Calculator](https://astrofree.vercel.app/numerology): Free Vedic numerology calculator by date of birth with 1–31 lookup tables.

## Tarot & Numerology Pillars

- [Major Arcana Meanings (All 22 Cards)](https://astrofree.vercel.app/major-arcana-tarot-cards-meanings): Complete Major Arcana table and The Fool's Journey stages.
- [All 78 Tarot Cards & Card of the Day](https://astrofree.vercel.app/tarot): Upright, reversed, love, career, and Card of the Day meanings for all 78 cards.
- [Reversed Tarot Cards Guide](https://astrofree.vercel.app/what-do-reversed-tarot-cards-mean): How to interpret upside-down cards in spreads.
- [Bhagyank Calculator](https://astrofree.vercel.app/bhagyank-calculator): Destiny number calculator by full date of birth.
- [Namank Calculator](https://astrofree.vercel.app/namank-calculator): Chaldean name numerology calculator.
- [Mulank vs Bhagyank Guide](https://astrofree.vercel.app/guide/mulank-vs-bhagyank): Difference between Birth Number and Destiny Number.
